explanation: The lemma says a property that holds a.e. on ℝ for Lebesgue measure holds a.e. for ‖x‖ under an additive Haar measure on E. It is proved from a local lemma, map_norm_absolutelyContinuous (the pushforward of μ by norm is absolutely continuous w.r.t. volume), plus ae_of_ae_map. I grepped Mathlib for lemmas about the pushforward of a measure by the norm, for ae_norm-style lemmas, and for a.e. statements involving ‖x‖ under Haar or volume. I also read HaarToSphere.lean (toSphere, volumeIoiPow, the polar-coordinate decomposition). None of these gives the a.e. transfer statement directly or in one or two lines.
